objectives.statement: Distinguish action verbs for putting something somewhere from state verbs for saying where something already is.
Use legge and ligge for flat or horizontal placement and position, and sette and sitte for seated or placed positions.
Use stå for upright position, text on a page, and objects placed ready for use.
Build natural Bokmål sentences with everyday object-position verbs.

notes: Must contrast placement/action verbs with position/state verbs: legge/ligge, sette/sitte, and stå. Include everyday object-position examples.
